[SWS_DM_00900] ClearDTC processing in case of memory er- rors
⌈
If the function Clear() of the ara::diag::DTCInformation instance
([SWS_DM_00671]) is called and the DM receives physical memory errors upon its
access to the Non-volatile Memory and thus cannot guarantee that the clear op-
eration was done successfully, the DM shall trigger the error kMemoryError.
⌋
